column1: # Measured median annual earnings for countries ILOSTAT has no earnings median for (designs/occupation-income.md, 4.5).
# median_male, median_female: the median annual earnings of each sex in `year`, in the local currency.
# median_total: used when the office publishes no split by sex; the subregion's sex gap splits it.
# Monthly figures are times 12, as ILOSTAT's are (section 4.1).
# uprate: the CPI factor from `year` to the price year (2025); blank takes ILOSTAT's CPI.
# Effects, spread and pay within a group come from the subregion; the level joins the subregion's
# ratio of earnings to GDP per capita and, when measured by sex, its sex gap.
# Each row needs a source note.
